customize_head:
<!-- KK OpenList Liquid Glass · MIT · see LICENSE and NOTICE -->
<style id="kk-openlist-glass">
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
 * Copyright (c) 2025 G.E.N.G
 * See LICENSE and NOTICE for attribution.
 */
/*
 * KK OpenList landscape adaptation of:
 * https://github.com/wugeng20/openlist-glassmorphism-theme
 * MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 G.E.N.G
 * Full upstream license is retained with this theme.
 */
:root {
  --kk-glass:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  --kk-glass-raised:rgba(249,252,255,.78);
  --kk-control:rgba(255,255,255,.34);
  --kk-edge:rgba(255,255,255,.67);
  --kk-shadow:0 14px 42px rgba(25,46,73,.13),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.42);
  --kk-blur:18px;
  --kk-hover:rgba(255,255,255,.36);
  --kk-ink:#1e3047;
  --kk-soft:#4b627a;
  --kk-veil:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(227,239,255,.14),rgba(226,237,250,.26));
}
.hope-ui-dark {
  --kk-glass:rgba(17,26,43,.55);
  --kk-glass-raised:rgba(18,28,47,.82);
  --kk-control:rgba(229,241,255,.065);
  --kk-edge:rgba(222,237,255,.16);
  --kk-shadow:0 16px 46px rgba(0,6,19,.24),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(245,250,255,.055);
  --kk-hover:rgba(205,229,255,.095);
  --kk-ink:#eef5ff;
  --kk-soft:#bbcce1;
  --kk-veil:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(5,12,25,.29),rgba(6,14,28,.44));
}
html { min-height:100%; background:#c6d8ea; }
html.hope-ui-dark { background:#111b2c; }
body { background:transparent!important; color:var(--kk-ink); }
#kk-wallpaper { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:none; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667d9e,#a3c7dc 56%,#c8b9df); }
#kk-wallpaper::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:var(--kk-veil); }
#kk-wallpaper img { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:center; opacity:0; transition:opacity .65s ease; }
#kk-wallpaper img.is-current { opacity:1; }
#root { position:relative; z-index:1; min-height:100vh; background:transparent!important; }
#root>.header { border-bottom:1px solid var(--kk-edge); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(20,35,65,.06); }
.body { background:transparent!important; }
/* Semantic OpenList selectors plus the upstream theme's Hope UI component map. */
#root>.header,.body>.nav,.obj-box,.markdown:not(:empty),
.hope-modal__content,.hope-drawer__content,.hope-popover__content,
.hope-menu__content,.hope-select__content,.hope-tooltip,.hope-notification,
.solid-contextmenu,[role=dialog],[role=menu],[role=listbox],
.hope-c-PJLV-ijgzmFG-css,.hope-c-PJLV-ikJQsXT-css,.hope-c-hOYTCS,
.hope-c-zbPwS,.hope-c-XJURY,.hope-c-cFbQhW,.hope-c-gIqhpo,
.hope-c-PJLV-idMNcPR-css,.hope-c-PJLV-ieGWMbI-css,.hope-c-PJLV-iZZmce-css,
.hope-c-PJLV-ifjOQLV-css,.hope-c-PJLV-iubUra-css,
.hope-c-PJLV-ihVEsOa-css,.hope-c-cIFneQ,.hope-c-PJLV-ikAHMBe-css {
  background:var(--kk-glass)!important;
  border:1px solid var(--kk-edge)!important;
  box-shadow:var(--kk-shadow)!important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(var(--kk-blur)) saturate(125%);
  backdrop-filter:blur(var(--kk-blur)) saturate(125%);
}
.body>.nav { border-radius:15px; padding:10px 15px; overflow:visible; }
.body>.nav::after { display:none; }
.obj-box { border-radius:21px!important; overflow:hidden; }
.hope-c-PJLV-ifjOQLV-css,.hope-c-PJLV-iubUra-css { border-radius:23px!important; }
/* These are OpenList's decorative login SVG backgrounds, not login controls. */
.hope-c-PJLV-ieMfKuk-css,.hope-c-PJLV-idCzYms-css,
.hope-c-PJLV-ifJliWT-css,.hope-c-PJLV-igjRXTJ-css,
.hope-c-PJLV-ihWgyFw-css,.hope-c-PJLV-ibiABng-css { display:none!important; }
.obj-box>.list,.obj-box .title,.obj-box .list-item,
.markdown-body,.header-right { background:transparent!important; }
.obj-box .title { color:var(--kk-soft); border-bottom:1px solid var(--kk-edge); }
.obj-box .list-item { transition:background-color .18s ease; border-radius:10px; }
.obj-box .list-item:hover,.obj-box .list-item[data-selected=true],
.hope-menu__item:hover,.solid-contextmenu__item:hover { background:var(--kk-hover)!important; }
.obj-box .list-item .name { color:var(--kk-ink); }
.obj-box .size,.obj-box .modified { color:var(--kk-soft); }
.markdown { border-radius:20px; }
.markdown-body .highlight pre,.markdown-body pre { background:var(--kk-control)!important; border:1px solid var(--kk-edge); border-radius:12px; }
.hope-notification .markdown,.hope-notification .markdown-body,.notify-render .markdown-body { background:transparent!important; box-shadow:none!important; }
.hope-button,.hope-input,.hope-select__trigger,.hope-textarea,
.header-right.hope-stack>div {
  background:var(--kk-control)!important;
  border:1px solid var(--kk-edge)!important;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.hope-button { border-radius:11px; color:var(--kk-ink); }
.hope-button:hover { background:var(--kk-hover)!important; }
.hope-input,.hope-textarea { border-radius:11px; color:var(--kk-ink); }
.hope-input::placeholder,.hope-textarea::placeholder { color:var(--kk-soft); opacity:.8; }
.hope-input:focus,.hope-textarea:focus { border-color:rgba(102,166,230,.8)!important; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(99,165,233,.15)!important; }
.hope-modal__content,.hope-drawer__content,.hope-popover__content,
.hope-menu__content,[role=dialog],[role=menu],[role=listbox],.solid-contextmenu {
  background:var(--kk-glass-raised)!important;
  border-radius:18px;
}
.hope-modal__overlay,.hope-drawer__overlay,.hope-c-ctSAUo {
  background:rgba(9,20,37,.28)!important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
  backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
}
.hope-ui-light .footer,.hope-ui-dark .footer {
  opacity:1!important; color:var(--kk-ink);
  text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.3);
}
.footer>div { padding:7px 14px; background:var(--kk-glass); border:1px solid var(--kk-edge); border-radius:999px; -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px); }
.hope-ui-dark .footer { text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3); }
.hope-ui-dark .markdown-body a { color:#a7d5ff!important; }
::selection { background:rgba(107,164,229,.3); }
#kk-wallpaper-tools { position:fixed; left:20px; bottom:18px; z-index:20; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; padding:4px; border:1px solid var(--kk-edge); border-radius:999px; background:var(--kk-glass); box-shadow:var(--kk-shadow); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px); }
#kk-wallpaper-tools button,#kk-wallpaper-tools a { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; min-height:32px; padding:0 10px; border:0; border-radius:999px; color:var(--kk-ink); background:transparent; text-decoration:none; font:12px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; }
#kk-wallpaper-tools button:hover,#kk-wallpaper-tools a:hover { background:var(--kk-hover); }
#kk-wallpaper-tools button:disabled { cursor:wait; }
#kk-wallpaper-tools svg { width:15px; height:15px; }
#kk-wallpaper-tools a { font-size:11px; opacity:.78; border-left:1px solid var(--kk-edge); border-radius:0 999px 999px 0; }
#kk-wallpaper-tools :focus-visible { outline:2px solid #79b8f2; outline-offset:2px; }
@media(max-width:720px) {
  :root { --kk-blur:13px; --kk-glass:rgba(255,255,255,.61); }
  .hope-ui-dark { --kk-glass:rgba(17,26,43,.63); }
  .obj-box { border-radius:16px!important; }
  .body>.nav { border-radius:13px; padding:9px 12px; }
  #kk-wallpaper-tools { left:12px; bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
  #kk-wallpaper-tools button,#kk-wallpaper-tools a { min-height:34px; padding:0 9px; }
  .footer { padding-bottom:65px!important; }
}
@supports not ((backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px))) {
  :root { --kk-glass:rgba(247,251,255,.91);--kk-glass-raised:rgba(247,251,255,.96); }
  .hope-ui-dark { --kk-glass:rgba(18,28,47,.91);--kk-glass-raised:rgba(18,28,47,.96); }
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
  #kk-wallpaper img,.obj-box .list-item { transition:none!important; }
}
/* Keep hidden controls hidden even with the flex toolbar rule. */
#kk-wallpaper[hidden],#kk-wallpaper-tools[hidden] { display:none!important; }
#kk-wallpaper-status { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip-path:inset(50%); white-space:nowrap; border:0; }

</style>
